scope: Actual expected-model correction candidates; no full-role valuation adoption
prospect: Audit identity-stable scouting evidence and replay previously rejected mean-shifting comparators. No adoption of failed smoothing or invented value floor.
pitcher: Replay preserved chronological debut-capacity candidates before implementing another estimator. Minor-league innings inform capacity only, never MLB talent rates or assumed MLB opportunities.
reliever: Separate save and hold probability per verified pure-relief appearance. Shrink observed events to fixed 2010-2012 relief priors using candidate appearance pseudocounts [5,10,20,40]. Infer expected appearance count from production expected IP and independently smoothed observed IP/appearance. Hold production IP and other talent counts fixed.
selection: Select pseudocount on 2016-2018 chronological development SVH7 mean absolute error, breaking ties by utility MAE. Evaluate unchanged selection on 2021-2024 anchors. Reject if either later SVH7 or utility MAE worsens; inspect individual SV and HLD error separately.
coverage: Saved chronological identity holdout and previously inspected cases are exposed evaluation, not a new independent holdout. Exclude mixed-role observations and unmatched appearances. No future records in predictors.
invariants: QA3 definition, component ratios, common category scale, replacement-access treatment, utility and attrition unchanged. Preserve two-way, unsupported and mixed-role routes.
release: First-year-only reliever changes may pass first-year gates. Years2-8 remain unchanged. No prospect or pitcher-capacity candidate is adopted when its historical gate fails. No independent eight-year validation claim.
